summary: Retest of the fault card title change and the minor items from iteration_290. (1) faultTitle and faultMetaLine: a node unit harness made 612 assertions and all passed. These cover both production cases exactly: prefix model 'MNLPNN0' gives 'Technogym Lat Pulldown' with 'S/N MNLPNN020100194', and the real model gives 'Technogym SKILLMILL' with 'Self-Powered Treadmill · S/N DJK04D22000131'. The harness also ran 600 machine_type/supplier/date/ref combinations: none produced a leading, trailing or double ' | '. (2) Backend: 5 new tests for the legacy machine_name backfill (now before the enrichment) plus iteration_290's 16 tests: 21 of 21 pass, and resend/send_email stay mocked. (3) UI on /pulse (pulse_pro, LiteFaultsTab) and /dashboard (gym, FaultsTab) at 1920 and 390: titles, the small line, the meta line, the 'Sent to Inda Fitness' badge and the 'View supplier card' link all render correctly. A legacy machine_name-only issue shows 'Concept2 Model D' / 'Rower · S/N LEGACY-SN-0003'. There is no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth == innerWidth at both widths). No real email was sent. All TEST_ rows were removed by id.

ui_bugs.issue: The machine type is dropped from the meta line only when the title itself came from the machine type (titleIsType). If the title comes from a model or name that happens to equal machine_type, the type still repeats. Example: equipment_model 'Treadmill' with no make, plus machine_type 'Treadmill', gives title 'Treadmill' and meta 'Treadmill | <date>'. This is an edge case and not in real data seen so far. Possible fix: also drop machine_type when it equals the title, ignoring case.

issues: A long org name ('TEST_ UI291 gym') wraps onto 3 lines next to the logo in the black header. This was already there before this change.

action_items: Optional: in faultMetaLine, also drop machine_type when it equals the title, ignoring case, not only when titleIsType
critical_code_review_comments: get_issues: the backfill now runs before _batch_enrich_equipment. Verified that it is not persisted, does not leak across orgs, and does not overwrite an existing serial_number.
The coverage_meta.equipment_id lookup in _batch_enrich_equipment is still not org-scoped. Low risk because ids are UUIDs.
The component calls faultTitle(issue) 3-4 times per card (title, subtitle check, subtitle, and inside faultMetaLine). Calling it once per card and reusing the result would be cheaper. Minor.
seed_data_creation: pytest seeds TEST_org_legacy_<run> orgs, a user, equipment and issues directly in test_database, then deletes them by id at teardown. UI seed: tests/_seed_fault_title_ui_291.py seed|clean creates TEST_ui291_pro / TEST_ui291_gym (user test_ui291_<x>@example.test / TestUiFault#2026). It has been cleaned, and a regex count shows 0 leftovers.
